name: Wall of Stone
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

You create a wall of stone within medium range that is 10 ft high, 5 ft thick, and up to 50 ft long or a circular wall with a diameter of short range. Check any number of Conditions and roll Spirit to set the Difficulty.

Each creature that is within the wall when it's created must roll Dexterity against the Difficulty. On a failure, the creature takes 1d10 damage and is pushed out of the wall, in a direction you choose. On a pass, it takes half damage and is pushed out of the wall in a direction it chooses.

A creature attempting to climb over the wall must roll Strength against the Difficulty or fall.

For each Condition you checked (twice for Guilty), choose one:

  • The wall becomes 10 ft longer or taller, or the diameter increases by 10 ft.

  • +1d damage.

Describe how you create the wall.
successes:
✨: Whenever the wall deals damage to a creature, the creature is knocked prone.

🌞: Double the height of the wall.
